title: AutoFeatureTour fixture (platforms/<name>/fixtures/<fixture>.json)
description: Test data a tour needs: values, hooks to create/remove it, and browser steps run off camera before the first scene.

$schema.description: This file's schema, for editors: a relative path to schemas/<type>.schema.json.

data.description: Values, as {data.<key>} in tours and steps.

items.description: One piece of test data: how to see it is there, set it up and undo it.

name.description: Shown in reports and the ledger.

check.description: A hook that succeeds when the data is already there: setup is skipped ("already in place") and nothing is undone. Run again after setup: still failing is a SCRIPT failure (the setup didn't do its job).

teardown.description: Removes it ({artifact.x.y} and {run.tag} allowed). Runs only if setup ran.

readOnly.description: Nothing is created (a lookup): no teardown expected, even on a shared environment.

items.description: Paired setup/teardown items, run in order before the browser starts; undone in reverse after it closes, and only the ones that ran. Each is recorded in the run's ledger.json before it runs, so `aft cleanup` can finish the undo after a crash.
A setup/teardown hook, run off camera with BASE_URL, RUN_DIR and RUN_TAG set.

cwd.description: Working folder, relative to the file.

output.description: Use what it prints (or the HTTP response) as data: "json" (an object merged into data) or "text" (trimmed, as data.<as>). Setup hooks only.

pin.description: With "output": pin what it created as an artifact of this name ({artifact.<pin>.<field>}; fields: the JSON object, or { <as>: text }), shown as "created by setup".

role.description: With "pin": what kind of thing it is (account, case…); {artifact[<role>].<field>} is the latest of that role.

secret.description: With "pin": fields that are secrets (redacted everywhere).

cleanupSteps.description: Browser steps that undo "steps", off camera after the last scene, before the browser closes (also when a scene failed). Skipped when "checkSteps" found the data already in place.

readOnly.description: This fixture only reads existing data (nothing to clean up), even on a shared environment.
